Noah (CSM): Aurora Labs needs a short per-route QPS bump + IP allowlist for their Brazil pilot tomorrow 09:30 BRT. Can eng help with region pin and autorevoke?
Camila (Aurora Labs): Confirm. Routes: POST /v1/classify 180->900 qps, websocket /v1/stream 100->600 qps for 5h. Source CIDRs: 44.200.16.0/22 and 44.200.20.0/22. We'll pin to sa-east-1. ASN: 64721.
Theo (NetEng): We can do per-route overrides and tag as aurora-bz-launch-temp. Will set auto-revoke 14:30 UTC. Quick Q: do you need header-based routing or plain CIDR?
Camila (Aurora Labs): CIDR is fine. We'll ramp over 20m. Please keep monitoring tight; renewal conversation next month so want smooth launch.
Priya (Oncall): I'll add alerts: 5xx > 0.8% for 5m, P95 > 850ms for 5m, token-cost spike >20%. Rollback if any trigger.
peering-bot: peering-bot: Peering pre-check started for ASN 64721; awaiting traceroute sample.
Theo (NetEng): Staging smoke passed. Staging command used:
```
redwoodctl rate-window create --name aurora-bz-launch-3820 \\
  --cidrs 44.200.16.0/22,44.200.20.0/22 \\
  --routes /v1/classify=900,/v1/stream=600 \\
  --region sa-east-1 --start 2026-03-30T09:30:00-03:00 --end 2026-03-30T14:30:00Z \\
  --tags customer-temp,aurora,autorevoke
```
Ticket INF-3710 created. Will promote to prod 15m before start for final checks.
Noah (CSM): Thanks. Camila please post traceroute and final ramp plan. Theo/Priya we'll coordinate rollback cadence. I'll schedule renewal touchpoint post-launch. :rocket:
Camila (Aurora Labs): Traceroute posted and ramp plan sent (10%, 30%, 60%, 100% over 20m). Thanks everyone.
Priya (Oncall): Monitoring hooks in place; I'll post a short summary after auto-revoke.
